snippet.title: Restitched | Design Tool Feature
snippet.description:
The #Restitched "Design Tool" 🛠️ is a powerful, essential feature in both the level editor and wardrobe. Use it to easily recolor nearly any asset! In some cases, you can also set a 'secondary color' and switch between preset texture swatches.

🚧 In these short featurette videos, you can learn more about the tools and content Restitched offers... 🛠️ From gameplay to customization and level building, there's a whole world of creativity to unpack! 

----------------------------------------------------
⭐ Restitched on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361090/Restitched/
